fact: Subscribers: 15,384 at 2025-06 (Q2 2025), per the NCA, satellite internet subscriptions in Ghana, up from 10,362 at Q4 2024 and 11,982 at Q1 2025.
Subscribers: 2,666 at 2024-03 (Q1 2024), per the NCA, satellite internet subscriptions in Ghana before Starlink was licensed.
The NCA states it licensed Starlink in April 2024, under the Satellite Licensing Framework 2024, and that Ghana has 29 satellite licences of which 11 provide last-mile connectivity.
The NCA states satellite internet subscriptions in Ghana exceeded 15,000 by June 2025, sold by licensed last-mile satellite providers (11 licensed), following Starlink's licensing.
The NCA states all administrative and licensing procedures with it for Space X Starlink GH LTD were concluded, with operations to start by the end of August 2024.
Le360 lists Ghana among 29 African countries that had granted Starlink a licence as of May 2026; no Ghana-specific detail or date is given (article date used).
The NCA approved the application of Space X Starlink GH LTD to offer satellite broadband services in Ghana; licence issuance was still being administratively completed.
MyBroadband lists Ghana as 'Available' for Starlink in its table of African markets; dated by the article's publication date (2026-07-17).
